component.name: Light Matter
component.summary: Light Matter is an HDR image and photo viewer

description.p: Light Matter is an HDR image and photo viewer for Windows and Linux. It features a simple and intuitive UI, photo browser with customisable locations, support for both High Dynamic Range (HDR) and Standard Dynamic Range (SDR) images, wide colour gamut, and ICC profiles.
Supported image formats: JPEG, JPEG UltraHDR, JPEG XL, AVIF, PNG, WebP, GIF.
Supported colour gamuts: sRGB, AdobeRGB, P3, BT.2020/BT.2100, custom colour primaries.
Supported HDR EOTF: PQ (SMPTE ST 2084), HLG (ARIB STD-B67).

ul.li: Updated dependencies to fix security vulnerabilities.
Added AppStream metadata to AppImage package.
Added missing MIME types to Linux build.
Added thumbnail size selector in the gallery.
Added zooming with a scroll wheel (thanks, iuncus!).
Implemented image grouping by year and month in the gallery view.
Escape key now closes the image viewer.

description.p: The first AppImage release of Light Matter.

ul.li: Major performance improvement for a gallery.
Greatly reduced memory usage when generating thumbnails.
Thumbnail generator is now multithreaded and does not cause UI stutters.
